notes: First scattered-light detection of the RY Lup transition disk (VLT/SPHERE IRDIS+IFS). The disk appears as a dominating double-arch structure extending to 0.53 arcsec (80 au) in radius, seen at high inclination (PA ~107 deg), with faint spiral-like features in the SE possibly due to planet-disk interaction (Langlois et al. 2018).
